title: Gate approvals are pinned to one commit

steps.text: One pull request, one commit: the head is a1b2c3d
Each gate posts its verdict on that exact commit
Then a push moves the head to e4f5a6b
Statuses belong to a commit, so the new head has none
gate:merge refuses until all three are re-run
All green on the new head: the merge is pinned to e4f5a6b

refuse: Refusing to merge PR #24 at e4f5a6b:
- status gate/browser is not success on e4f5a6b
- status gate/review is not success on e4f5a6b
- status gate/uiux is not success on e4f5a6b
done: All gates green for PR #24 at e4f5a6b. Merging (squash).
